simple.prompt: I really enjoy ___ international podcasts during my morning commute.
simple.explanation: Kata kerja enjoy selalu diikuti oleh Gerund (verb-ing): enjoy listening to.

simple.prompt: We decided ___ the product launch until next quarter.
simple.explanation: Kata kerja decide selalu diikuti oleh to-infinitive: decided to postpone.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan gerund sebagai subjek kalimat.
simple.targetSentence: Learning foreign languages opens new career opportunities.
simple.explanation: Gerund (Learning) bertindak sebagai subjek kalimat tunggal.
hints: Awali dengan gerund subjek Learning foreign languages.
Main verb adalah opens new career opportunities.

simple.prompt: She promised ___ the finalized quarterly forecast by Friday afternoon.
simple.explanation: Promise diikuti oleh to-infinitive: promised to send.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan kata kerja avoid + gerund.
simple.targetSentence: Drivers should avoid using mobile phones while driving.
simple.explanation: Avoid selalu diikuti gerund: avoid using.

simple.prompt: The company hopes ___ its operations to European markets next year.
simple.explanation: Hope berpasangan dengan to-infinitive: hopes to expand.

simple.targetSentence: The suspect refused to answer any questions.
simple.explanation: Refuse berpasangan dengan to-infinitive: refused to answer.
hints: Verb dasar adalah answer any questions.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog perubahan makna pada kata kerja remember.
dialogue: Did you lock the front door?
Yes, I distinctly remember ___ it before leaving the house.
intermediate.explanation: Remember + gerund (-ing) berarti mengingat kembali aksi yang SUDAH dilakukan di masa lalu. Sebaliknya remember to lock berarti ingat untuk melakukan kewajiban.
hints: Mengingat kenangan aksi yang sudah dilakukan sebelumnya.

intermediate.prompt: Please remember ___ the front door before you leave for the airport tonight.
intermediate.explanation: Remember + to-infinitive berarti jangan lupa untuk melakukan suatu tugas/kewajiban di masa depan.
hints: Perintah/pengingat untuk jangan lupa melakukan tugas.

intermediate.prompt: The presentation was getting monotonous, so the speaker stopped ___ a sip of water.
intermediate.explanation: Stop + to-infinitive berarti berhenti sejenak dari suatu aktivitas DENGAN TUJUAN untuk melakukan hal lain. Stop taking berarti menghentikan kebiasaan minum.
hints: Berhenti sejenak demi tujuan tertentu (in order to).

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan look forward to + gerund.
intermediate.targetSentence: We look forward to collaborating with your team.
intermediate.explanation: Dalam frasa look forward to, kata to adalah PREPOSISI, sehingga wajib diikuti Gerund (-ing): collaborating.
hints: To di sini adalah preposisi, bukan to-infinitive.

intermediate.prompt: I will never forget ___ the Northern Lights in Iceland for the very first time.
intermediate.explanation: Forget + gerund merujuk pada kenangan masa lalu yang tidak akan pernah terlupakan.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan kata kerja suggest + gerund.
intermediate.targetSentence: The doctor suggested getting more regular sleep.
hints: Gunakan gerund getting more regular sleep.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog perubahan makna pada try.
dialogue: My head is throbbing with pain.
Try ___ a glass of cold water and resting in a dark room.
intermediate.explanation: Try + gerund berarti melakukan eksperimen/mencoba suatu metode sebagai solusi untuk melihat apakah efektif. Try to do berarti mengerahkan tenaga/usaha keras.
hints: Mencoba suatu metode sebagai eksperimen solusi.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan umum setelah frasa preposisi be used to.
complex.draft: The new flight attendants are used to work long shifts across time zones.
options: The new flight attendants are used to working long shifts across time zones.
The new flight attendants used to working long shifts across time zones.
The new flight attendants are used to be working long shifts across time zones.
complex.explanation: Be used to berarti terbiasa dengan suatu kondisi. Huruf to di sini adalah preposisi, sehingga WAJIB diikuti Gerund (-ing): are used to working.
hints: Be used to (terbiasa) diikuti oleh gerund (-ing).

complex.prompt: We regret ___ you that your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion.
complex.explanation: Regret + to-infinitive adalah formula formal untuk menyampaikan kabar buruk dengan penuh sesal. Regret + gerund menyatakan penyesalan atas aksi masa lalu.
hints: Gunakan formula regret to inform you.

complex.prompt: The historic building is in terrible disrepair; the roof needs ___ before winter arrives.
complex.explanation: Struktur pasif unik: need + gerund (atau need to be repaired) bermakna pasif: atap tersebut perlu diperbaiki.
hints: Need + gerund memiliki makna pasif (needs repairing = needs to be repaired).

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan possessive case sebelum gerund (formal style).
complex.targetSentence: The board appreciated his taking the initiative.
complex.explanation: Dalam bahasa Inggris formal baku, kata benda atau pronoun sebelum gerund menggunakan bentuk possessive: his taking the initiative (bukan him taking).
hints: Gunakan possessive pronoun his sebelum gerund taking.
Formal style mensyaratkan possessive sebelum gerund.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kekeliruan gerund setelah frasa it is no use.
complex.draft: It is no use to complain about circumstances beyond our direct control.
options: It is no use complaining about circumstances beyond our direct control.
It is no use complain about circumstances beyond our direct control.
It is no use of complaining about circumstances beyond our direct control.
complex.explanation: Idiom It is no use / It is no good selalu berpasangan dengan Gerund (-ing): It is no use complaining.
hints: Idiom It is no use diikuti oleh gerund.

complex.prompt: He is accused of financial fraud, but he denies ___ any unauthorized transactions.
complex.explanation: Deny diikuti oleh gerund. Untuk menekankan bahwa peristiwa terjadi sebelumnya, gunakan Perfect Gerund: denies having authorized.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog negosiasi dengan frasa object to + gerund.
dialogue: Do the staff members agree to the new roster?
Several senior nurses object to ___ weekend shifts without overtime premiums.
complex.explanation: Object to adalah phrasal verb di mana to adalah preposisi, sehingga wajib diikuti Gerund: object to working.
hints: Object to (keberatan terhadap) diikuti oleh gerund (-ing).
